title: Sparrowfall Knowledge
text:
Sparrowfall Knowledge

['2026-02-15 - Inbound via docs-search webinar signup. CTO (L. Rivera) created self-serve account and ran quick embed test.', '2026-02-20 - Discovery call (30m) w/ Maya, Ravi. Fireflies: ff_2026-02-20_3312. Topics: embeddings + reranking flow, vector DB options.', 'Customer quote: "We need sub-300ms end-to-end for top-k search in UI, and keep per-doc index costs under $0.01/mo approx."', 'Primary workload: documentation + policy RAG for customer support KB. Expect ~50k docs initially, 200-300k tokens/day ingestion spikes.', 'They tried Redwood hosted API embeddings (small batch) - liked latency and simple API; asked about batching guidance and cost per 1M tokens.', 'Vector DB integration questions: prefer Pinecone or Weaviate; asked if Redwood has direct connectors or recommended pipelines. Also asked about chunking strategy (chunk size 512-1024 tokens?)', 'Reranking: want pipeline where initial ANN returns 100 candidates and hosted model does rerank; concerned about rerank cost and per-query latency.', 'Latency/throughput targets: UI snappy target = 200-300ms tail for average user, background long-running async allowed for heavy queries. Throughput: ~30 qps peak for small team.', 'Security: SSO for admin console (SAML) required; audit logs for embeddings and API calls requested. Data residency not strict yet (US cloud ok).', 'Proof-of-concept asks: sample ingestion script (python), sample Redwood embeddings call + vector db connector snippet, cost estimate for 50k docs + monthly queries.', 'Action items assigned: Maya to send quickstart + ingestion script by 2026-03-04; Ravi to schedule 30m tech deep-dive w/ engineer (they prefer Fri mornings).', 'Roadblocks: legal wants short note on retention & deletion for embeddings, engineering needs guidance on batch size and KV cache to minimize tokens.', 'Notes from call: they currently use Algolia for metadata search but not sem search; evaluating replacing metadata layer with vector approach for better relevance.', 'They requested references of similar SMB customers and a one-page cost calc. Mentioned competitors: tested OpenAI embeddings + Pinecone (expensive).', '2026-03-02 - Follow-up email sent with sample script + link to docs. Waiting on reply from CTO about preferred vector DB. Gmail thread id thread-17a2b9-sf.', 'Jira ticket RAG-45 opened to track tech Qs (chunking, rerank latency, recommended ANN size).']
